title: Citation
description: An inline source marker for a sentence that makes a claim. The reader taps or tabs to the marker and a popover lists every source behind the claim: who published it, what kind of source it is, and the exact words quoted from it. Several sources stack in…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/citation

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/citation.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/citation';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/citation

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
